title: Conversation Topics
summary: We talked about which topics are OK and which are taboo when you meet someone for the first time. We listened to Zhang and Dewi and learned the 'Three A's' (Answer, Add, Ask) to make a conversation two-way. We also learned extreme adjectives like freezing, furious and hilarious.

grammar.title: Extreme adjectives
grammar.explain: Extreme adjectives already mean 'very + adjective': freezing means very cold. So we don't use 'very' with them. Use 'absolutely' or 'really', or use the extreme adjective alone.
grammar.explain_ar: الصفات القصوى (extreme adjectives) تحمل بالفعل معنى «جداً + صفة»؛ فكلمة freezing تعني «بارد جداً». لذلك لا نستخدم very معها، بل نستخدم absolutely أو really، أو نستخدم الصفة وحدها.
form: very / really + normal adjective: very cold, really tired
absolutely / really + extreme adjective: absolutely freezing, really exhausted
cold → freezing, hot → boiling, angry → furious, tired → exhausted, dirty → filthy
funny → hilarious, small → tiny, big → enormous / huge, scary → terrifying, good → wonderful / fantastic

examples.en: It's not just cold outside – it's absolutely freezing!
She was furious when the meeting was cancelled.
After the flight I felt completely exhausted.
examples.note: completely also works with extreme adjectives

examples.en: Their flat is very small. / Their flat is tiny.
examples.note: very + normal adjective, or the extreme adjective alone

mistakes.right: This is hilarious. / This is absolutely hilarious.
mistakes.why: Use an extreme adjective instead of 'very very'.

mistakes.right: It's very cold today. / It's absolutely freezing today.
mistakes.why: 'Absolutely' goes with extreme adjectives, not normal ones.

quiz.q: Open the window! It's ___ in here.
quiz.why: Boiling = very hot. Don't add 'very', and 'absolutely' doesn't go with 'hot'.

quiz.q: What is the extreme adjective for 'dirty'?
The flat is ___ – just one small room.

quiz.why: Use absolutely with extreme adjectives like furious.
